comment: The banana bread toasted is such an upgrade. Please never take it off.
Batch filter was ready instantly and genuinely excellent today.
Waited 14 minutes for a cortado at 9am. The queue wasn't moving and nobody said anything.
Oat flat white is the best in the area, no contest.
Soup and a sourdough heel for £7 is a steal. Warm and fast.
Ran out of almond croissants before 11 again. Third time this month.
Asked for something not sweet and got pointed at the long black. Exactly right.
Oat milk option on everything makes this my default spot.
